weather.summary: Partly Sunny then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: Sticky again, with a shot at afternoon storms. Relief arrives Friday.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is near full, a comfortable cushion heading into fall.

pollen.note: Tree 2 · Grass 2 · Weed 3 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are up. Allergy folks, take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: A warm afternoon load, with plenty of supply to spare.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 29 minutes today, and down by 7:01 p.m.
